subject: Re: Post-demo recap & follow-up — model fit / recent v2.3 regression?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — model fit for FinTechCorp

Alex — great running through the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary:
- Recommended model family: redwood-rank-gen-v2 (we recommended the v2.2 variant for your routing-sensitive prompts)
- Primary concerns you raised: financial term precision and conservative hallucination behavior on short-context prompts
- Deliverables attached: prompt_set_v1.jsonl (sample prompts we ran during the call) and benchmark_summary_20260410.pdf (high-level metrics across candidate variants)

Suggested next steps: 
1) You share a 200–500 prompt sample (we can use the attached prompt_set as a template).
2) We run an in-depth eval against your prompt set + our regression harness and share a diff report.
3) If any quality delta appears, we can pin your production rollout to a stable model version while we investigate.

Proposed timeline:
- We can kick off the eval Monday and should have a preliminary diff within 24–48 hours.
- If you want immediate protection, we can pin your tenant to v2.2 while we run the deeper analysis.

Attaching prompt_set_v1.jsonl & benchmark_summary_20260410.pdf for reference.

Thanks again — I’ll coordinate internally and loop back with a plan and a Jira ticket for tracking.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — model fit for FinTechCorp

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the artifacts. Quick heads-up: we ran a quick integration smoke test against our staging traffic (using the same prompt patterns) and saw a noticeable quality drop after the vendor-side model update that pushed v2.3 last week.

Example: one of our shortening prompts used to produce a conservative summary with no added assumptions; after v2.3 it started injecting speculative statements (we have a sample in the attachment of the thread). The change materially impacts compliance sign-off for certain workflows.

Can Redwood pin our tenant to the previous stable version while you run the eval? We need to avoid rolling back any downstream consumers ourselves. Also happy to provide additional sample prompts/logs — I’ll get those over by EOD.

—Alex
Alex Garcia | Head of ML Integrations | FinTechCorp
alex.garcia@fintechcorp.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap & follow-up — FinTechCorp — regression observed (escalation)

Team — forwarding Alex's note. FinTechCorp saw a quality regression after our recent v2.3 rollout; they asked to be pinned to the prior stable version while we investigate.

Can you: 
- Confirm whether the v2.3 rollout included any changes to decoding defaults or prompt preprocessing that could explain the shift.
- Produce a quick diff (metric + qualitative) against the prompt_set_v1 we attached; ideally a PDF we can share.
- If confirmed, advise on options for tenant-level pinning (immediate) and a short remediation plan (canary + fix).

I’ve opened INF-3421 (Jira) to track; please add findings and attach the diff report. I’ve cc’d Laura for any contractual/ops implications. This is time-sensitive — Alex needs a plan to present to procurement by tomorrow.

—Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo recap & follow-up — FinTechCorp — regression observed (investigation)

Putting findings here from an initial pass: 

Summary: we reproduced the regression on FinTechCorp's sample prompts. Root cause appears to be an unintended change in the sampling temperature schedule and a small reweighting in the safety post-filter introduced as part of v2.3 kernel tuning. The model params changed but the published model tag was updated without the downstream-inference-config delta.

What we did: 
- Ran the benchmark harness against prompt_set_v1.jsonl for v2.2 vs v2.3 (deterministic seed).
- Collected token-level diffs and end-to-end answer comparison.

Artifacts attached: regression_diff_report_v2.3.pdf (includes metric deltas, sample-side-by-side outputs, and recommended remediation).

Short-term remediation options (pick one):
1) Immediate tenant pin to redwood-rank-gen-v2.2 (we can apply this at the routing layer for FinTechCorp within 30 minutes).
2) Canary v2.3 with prompt-level overrides (run v2.3 on 5% of traffic with extra monitoring + rollback triggers).
3) Patch v2.3 with restored sampling schedule + run green-canary again (ETA 48–72 hrs).

Recommended: Option 1 (pin to v2.2) for immediate protection, then Option 3 to fix v2.3 and validate on a canary. I’ll submit a rollback request and add the tenant pin config to the rollout service if you approve.

Links: perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/compare/fintech-v2.2-v2.3
Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-3421

—Dev
Dev Patel | Senior SRE, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — model fit for FinTechCorp (plan)

Alex — thanks for the quick test and for offering to send more samples.

Plan of action (agreed internally):
- Immediate: pin FinTechCorp tenant to redwood-rank-gen-v2.2 (Dev will apply at the routing layer within 30 minutes). This prevents any further exposure to the v2.3 delta while we investigate.
- Investigation: Dev attached regression_diff_report_v2.3.pdf (copied above). We’ll run the full regression harness against your EOD sample once you send it; that will be added to INF-3421.
- Remediation: we’ll patch the sampling schedule in v2.3 and run a green canary; no production unpinning will happen until your team signs off on the canary metrics.

Next steps for you: send the additional prompt/log samples (if you can, include the exact request IDs). I’ll schedule a 30-min sync with Dev and Laura for tomorrow to walk through the diff and the rollback details — proposed: 2026-04-12 11:00 AM PDT. Does that work?

Links & artifacts: regression_diff_report_v2.3.pdf (attached), benchmark_summary_20260410.pdf (prior), and mutual action plan: next_steps_fintech_mop.docx (attached).

We’ll keep this ticket updated: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-3421

Thanks — we’ll prioritize this.

—Marissa
